items.headline: StarkWare's OffMarket Brings Private Trading to Polymarket
items.summary: StarkWare opened OffMarket to the public, letting Polymarket users trade without linking positions to their accounts. A big privacy push for the $STRK ecosystem.

items.headline: $HEX Founder Richard Heart Detained in Istanbul
items.summary: Turkish reports say $HEX and PulseChain founder Richard Heart was detained, with $4M and 64 watches seized. Police have yet to officially confirm.

items.headline: $PUMP Callout Scandal: Wallets Traded Ahead of Calls
items.summary: Bubblemaps alleges Anglio-linked wallets front-ran Pump.fun callouts, pocketing ~$50K in trading profits plus $80K in rewards as $PUMP shifts payouts to follower returns.

items.headline: $RPL Voters Back rETH Withdrawals in Saturn 2
items.summary: Rocket Pool voters approved random megapool exits for $RPL's rETH withdrawals while keeping 4 ETH bonds. Full Saturn 2 ratification is still pending.

items.headline: $EKUBO Adds Shadow Accounts for Private LP Positions
items.summary: Ekubo's new Shadow Accounts let liquidity providers obscure positions using existing pools rather than a separate private market. A fresh DeFi privacy primitive on Starknet.
